questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Prepositions of Time: In vs On vs At
questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition of time:
"The Supreme Court Bench will assemble ___ 10:30 AM to pronounce the verdict."
questions.explanation: Specific clock times (jaise 10:30 AM, 5:00 PM, noon, midnight) ke pehle strictly preposition 'AT' ka use hota hai. 'In' broad time periods (months, years) ke liye hota hai, aur 'On' specific days/dates ke liye hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Time Preposition Pyramid — AT for exact clock times and pinpoint moments.
questions.hint: Exact clock time (hours and minutes) ke pehle kaunsa preposition lagta hai?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Prepositions of Time: Named Calendar Dates
questions.question:
Choose the correct preposition to complete the sentence:
"The Constitution of India was formally adopted ___ 26th November 1949."
questions.explanation: Specific calendar dates (jaise 26th November, 15th August) aur days of the week ke pehle strictly 'ON' lagta hai. Agar sirf year hota ('in 1949') ya sirf month hota ('in November'), tab 'in' lagta; lekin complete date aate hi 'ON' compulsory hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Time Preposition Pyramid — ON for 24-hour days and calendar dates.
questions.hint: Calendar date (day + month) ke pehle 'in' lagta hai ya 'on'?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"The original judicial records are safely preserved ___ the strongroom of the High Court."
questions.explanation: 'The strongroom' ek 3D enclosed space (chaaron taraf se enclosed kamra/vault) hai. Enclosed volumes aur rooms ke andar sthir position describe karne ke liye preposition 'IN' use hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-02: Place Preposition Matrix — IN for 3D enclosed spaces and rooms.
questions.hint: Enclosed room ya building ke andar hone par kaunsa preposition lagate hain?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: In vs Into: Static Rest vs Dynamic Boundary Traversal
questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the correct preposition:
"The agitated litigant rushed ___ the courtroom without seeking permission from the security staff."
questions.explanation: Action verb 'rushed' bahar se andar ki taraf dynamic motion show kar raha hai. Jab movement outside se inside 3D enclosure ki boundary cross karti hai, toh strictly 'INTO' lagta hai. 'In' static rest (already andar baithe hona) show karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: In vs Into — INTO for dynamic movement crossing boundary into an interior.
questions.hint: Action verb 'rushed' motion show kar raha hai jo exterior se interior ki taraf ja rahi hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: On vs Onto: Surface Landing Dynamics
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"The court orderly gently placed the sealed envelope ___ the magistrate's table."
questions.explanation: Action verb 'placed' ek object ko move karke kisi open 2D surface ke upar rakhne (landing/depositing on surface) ka movement show kar raha hai. Is dynamic surface landing ke liye formal English mein 'ONTO' use hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: On vs Onto — ONTO for movement landing an entity onto a surface.
questions.hint: Object ko move karke surface ke upar rakhne ke liye kaunsa preposition aayega?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Destination vs Heading: To vs Towards
questions.question:
Choose the most appropriate preposition:
"The witnesses walked ___ the High Court building, but stopped at a nearby restaurant before reaching the entrance."
questions.explanation: Sentence explicitely bata raha hai ki witnesses raste mein restaurant par ruk gaye aur entrance tak nahi pahuche. 'To' destination tak pahunchne ko denote karta hai, jabki 'TOWARDS' sirf us direction mein heading show karta hai bina reaching guarantee ke.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-05: To vs Towards — TOWARDS for general directional heading without reaching target.
questions.hint: Check karein ki kya subject manzil tak pahuncha ya raste mein hi ruk gaya.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"The inquiry committee has directed the department to submit the compliance report ___ 5:00 PM on Friday."
questions.explanation: Verb 'submit' ek point-action event hai aur '5:00 PM on Friday' ek latest cut-off deadline hai (not later than). Deadlines ke liye strictly 'BY' lagta hai. 'Until' durative ongoing state ke liye hota hai ('stayed until 5 PM').
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-06: By vs Until — BY marks the latest deadline for a completed action.
questions.hint: Submission ek deadline par hota hai ya lagatar chalta rehta hai?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: By vs Until: Continuing Durative Action
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"The judicial magistrate instructed the court staff to remain in the office ___ the final order was signed."
questions.explanation: Verb 'remain' (stay) ek durative verb hai jo continuous ongoing state ko show karta hai. Jab action specified terminal event tak continuously chalta rahe, toh strictly 'UNTIL' (or till) lagta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-06: By vs Until — UNTIL marks the continuation of an action up to a terminal point.
questions.hint: Staff ko us samay tak lagatar office mein ruka rehna tha.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Since vs For: Measured Duration vs Starting Point
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"The registry has been scrutinizing these disputed election petitions ___ more than three weeks."
questions.explanation: 'More than three weeks' ek measured duration (period of time / quantity) hai. Duration ke pehle hamesha 'FOR' lagta hai. 'Since' tab lagta jab starting date ya day diya hota ('since 1st October').
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-07: Since vs For — FOR with a period of measured duration.
questions.hint: 'Three weeks' duration (awadhi) hai ya calendar ka starting point?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.question:
Choose the grammatically correct sentence:
A) A trade agreement was negotiated among India, Japan, and Australia.
B) A trade agreement was negotiated between India, Japan, and Australia.
C) A trade agreement was negotiated with India, Japan, and Australia.
D) A trade agreement was negotiated amidst India, Japan, and Australia.
questions.explanation: Standard English grammar rule kehta hai ki jab 3 ya usse zyada entities individually named ho aur unke beech mutual/reciprocal bilateral treaty ya relationship ho, toh strictly 'BETWEEN' lagta hai, 'among' nahi. Option (B) bilkul correct hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-08: Between vs Among — BETWEEN for 3+ distinct, individually named entities in mutual relation.
questions.hint: Check karein ki kya teeno deshon ke naam alag-alag clearly diye gaye hain.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.question:
Identify the grammatically correct sentence:
A) The Division Bench discussed about the constitutional validity of the Act.
B) The Division Bench discussed the constitutional validity of the Act.
C) The Division Bench discussed on the constitutional validity of the Act.
D) The Division Bench discussed of the constitutional validity of the Act.
questions.explanation: Verb 'discuss' direct transitive verb hai jiska matlab hi hota hai 'talk about'. Iske baad kisi preposition ('about', 'on', 'of') ka use karna redundant pleonasm (grammatical error) hota hai. Direct object aayega: 'discussed the constitutional validity'.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-10: Zero Preposition Law — 'Discuss' takes a direct object without 'about'.
questions.hint: Kya verb 'discuss' ke baad 'about' lagana zaroori hai ya galat?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate word:
"___ a heavy monetary penalty, the High Court directed the contemnor to tender an unconditional apology."
questions.explanation: 'Besides' (with 's') ka matlab hota hai 'in addition to / apart from' (ke alawa/ke atirikt). Sentence ka matlab hai ki monetary penalty ke alawa unconditional apology bhi deni hogi. 'Beside' (bina 's') physical location (bagal mein) ke liye lagta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Beside vs Besides — BESIDES means 'in addition to'.
questions.hint: Yahan 'bagal mein' ka sense hai ya 'ke alawa / in addition to' ka sense hai?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11
